title: Field-Free Transverse Aharonov--Bohm Phase Gate for an Orbital $l$-Qubit
summary: The Aharonov--Bohm (AB) effect is usually read out through phase differences associated with spatially distinct electron paths. We show that confined orbital modes provide a same-path alternative: a core-confined magnetic flux writes opposite propagation phases on the co-propagating modes $|\pm l\rangle$ of a straight annular electron guide while the transported electron-wave support remains field free.
